llm_response.reason: The site mimics a legitimate lingerie outlet and uses a luxury brand name (Aubade) but has serious scam indicators: 1) Kontakt (Contact) and Datenschutz (Privacy Policy) pages return 404 errors, so there is no valid business or privacy information, which is never the case for legitimate e-commerce stores. 2) There are SSL certificate issues—a major warning sign for fake shops. 3) The structure and branding suggest possible spoofing of official outlets. 4) No clear company identification or physical address provided. These combined facts align with multiple scam signals: missing/improper business contacts (6), ambiguous privacy policy (7), spoofing of legitimate business designs (16), and security issues related to SSL.
